description: This file contains utilities for accessing fields in types via reflection, including delegate definitions for getting and setting values of fields, and methods for generating such delegates dynamically using Reflection.Emit. It is part of the Orleans.Serialization.Utilities namespace and focuses on efficient field access in serialization contexts.

methods.name: GetGetter
methods.description: Returns a delegate to get the value of a specified field, either by value or by reference.

methods.name: GetValueGetter
methods.description: Returns a delegate to get the value of a specified field by value.

methods.name: GetReferenceSetter
methods.description: Returns a delegate to set the value of a specified field by reference.

methods.name: GetValueSetter
methods.description: Returns a delegate to set the value of a specified field.

methods.name: GetSetter
methods.description: Internal method that creates a delegate to set the value of a specified field, supporting by reference or by value.
